text: The original 1424 changes missed reminders to false by default. Entry 1461 reverses only the two preference/default fallback files; both equal the original parent bytes. Entry 1467 restores those defaults and adds calendar.alarms.showmissed=true in three test manifests. The accepted user default and fallback remain false, while their migrated TOML test manifests keep true. Preserve a test feature precondition explicitly rather than depending on the product default. The backout reports test failures; no exact failure diagnostic was read. The original 1424 changes only these same two files, so this is a complete inverse of that landing. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Missed-reminder defaults and test preconditions are distinct policies
